checks.check: Predictions or new features no longer match the original sample identifiers or column order.
checks.how: Compare identifier sequences, join cardinalities and feature names before and after the changed transformation.

checks.check: The checkpoint, tokenizer or preprocessing metadata differs from the instantiated inference configuration.
checks.how: Compare stored architecture parameters, vocabulary sizes and transform settings with the active constructor; inspect missing and unexpected weight keys.

checks.check: Individual models produce varying outputs but the saved submission is constant, partial or duplicates a member.
checks.how: Trace array shapes, variances, accumulator counts and the final output variable on a small batch.

checks.check: A traceback identifies an import, callback signature, dataframe operation or device mismatch.
checks.how: Read the first failing traceback and inspect the arguments, installed module path, tensor devices and object types.

checks.check: No end-to-end run has yet produced a verified prediction file.
checks.how: Inspect run logs and verify whether a tiny input batch completes loading, transformation, prediction and output writing.

checks.check: Peak memory is reached while several models or intermediate matrices coexist.
checks.how: Inspect allocation logs and object lifetimes at the failed stage; measure peak memory on a representative batch.

checks.check: Repeated trials recompute identical upstream features or predictions.
checks.how: Compare stage timings and configuration hashes across recent runs to identify unchanged expensive stages.

checks.check: The current trial needs pipeline feedback before a full fold and estimator budget is justified.
checks.how: Check whether the trial changes code wiring or searches a parameter and whether reduced runs preserve a useful validation signal.

checks.check: Manual toggles, duplicated code or obsolete dependencies have caused integration errors.
checks.how: Compare recent tracebacks and diffs with the active configuration paths and repeated model-loading blocks.

checks.check: A final artifact is being generated with development-only fold or sample limits still enabled.
checks.how: Inspect effective run configuration and compare expected sample, fold and member counts with execution logs.

checks.check: The active pipeline crashes, produces invalid outputs or fails prediction parity against the working version.
checks.how: Run a small representative batch and compare shapes, identifiers, value ranges and saved outputs with the preserved baseline.

checks.check: Verified predictions are correct but measured runtime or peak memory prevents planned experiments.
checks.how: Check parity results alongside stage timing and memory logs.

checks.check: The last scored version changed several plausible causes of the score movement.
checks.how: Read the version diff and list changed data, model and prediction settings.

checks.check: The observed improvement is comparable to variation among unchanged reruns.
checks.how: Compare its delta with recorded baseline rerun range or paired-seed variation.

checks.check: A verified regression is much larger than prior gains from the proposed small adjustment.
checks.how: Compare the current score loss with repeated baseline results and the historical size of calibration or weight-tuning gains.

checks.check: A controlled sweep has a consistent improving direction and has not bracketed its optimum.
checks.how: Read the parameter-value and held-out-score table with other settings and seeds fixed.

checks.check: Recent controlled perturbations on both sides fail to improve beyond measured noise.
checks.how: Inspect the last sweep and repeated baseline results, including the effective blend weight of the component being tuned.

checks.check: A stable working configuration is unavailable for controlled comparisons.
checks.how: Check saved configurations, checkpoints and prediction artifacts for a reproducible baseline.

checks.check: Multiple rows share a subject, entity, topic or near-duplicate source that can leak across folds.
checks.how: Count repeated group identifiers and inspect overlap or clustering of similar examples across current folds.

checks.check: Rows are independent enough to split and rare labels are absent or highly uneven in current folds.
checks.how: Inspect group overlap and per-fold label counts or binned target distributions.

checks.check: A recognizable training population has a different distribution from the intended test population.
checks.how: Compare source metadata, label histograms and available test covariates by population.

checks.check: Current validation estimates fluctuate because each holdout has few informative examples.
checks.how: Compare fold sizes, target coverage and fold-score dispersion across existing runs.

checks.check: The same labeled sample appears in both training and validation for a fold.
checks.how: Intersect stable sample identifiers in each fold and trace special-subset insertion code.

checks.check: Reproducing a recorded overlapping-fold experiment is required and a separate untouched holdout exists.
checks.how: Confirm the experimental purpose, overlapping sample list and a disjoint holdout never used for model or threshold fitting.

checks.check: Model choices are frozen and independent validation has already selected the configuration.
checks.how: Check the experiment record and ensure final fitting will not be evaluated on its own training rows.

checks.check: Early stopping or further hyperparameter selection still relies on the reserved holdout.
checks.how: Inspect the training callbacks and remaining experiment plan.

checks.check: Current folds leak related rows or poorly represent the target population.
checks.how: Inspect identifier overlap and per-fold population and label distributions.

checks.check: Training selects checkpoints using a different objective direction or output convention from the task metric.
checks.how: Compare task scoring code with the evaluation callback, output activation and early-stopping configuration.

checks.check: The exact task metric is unstable across epochs while a smooth surrogate tracks held-out generalization better.
checks.how: Compare saved metric curves and the independent scores of checkpoints selected by each criterion.

checks.check: The data unit, temporal structure and missingness have not been established.
checks.how: Check whether a data profile reports entity history lengths, ordering, dtypes and missing-value rates.

checks.check: Existing scores come from a known-valid split but the cause or reproducibility of a change is unclear.
checks.how: Review split-integrity checks, version diffs and repeated-run scores.

checks.check: Reported validation gains disagree systematically with independent evaluations or the intended metric.
checks.how: Compare the checkpoint ranking across validation and independent scores, then inspect split membership and metric definitions.

checks.check: The task predicts entities with repeated time-ordered records but uses only one record or a narrow summary.
checks.how: Inspect rows per entity and compare current features with history statistics, recent windows and changes.

checks.check: Known relationships or metadata have predictive meaning absent from the current columns.
checks.how: Inspect available fields and prior residual slices for ratios, interactions or category-conditioned differences.

checks.check: Document quality depends on length, organization or language statistics not exposed by current representations.
checks.how: Compare target and residual distributions against paragraph counts, sentence lengths, readability and error rates.

checks.check: Useful text variation is lexical or topical and the current vocabulary filters discard it.
checks.how: Inspect token frequencies, vocabulary coverage and prior n-gram or topic-model ablations.

checks.check: A pretrained encoder is available and existing lexical features miss semantic similarity.
checks.how: Inspect sample errors, available encoder outputs and previous dense-feature ablations.

checks.check: A related predictor has valid out-of-fold predictions aligned to the current training rows.
checks.how: Verify held-out provenance, row identifiers and corresponding test predictions for the candidate model.

checks.check: The proposed prediction feature was generated by fitting on the same rows it predicts.
checks.how: Trace model fit indices and prediction indices for every candidate feature row.

checks.check: Many current features have weak or unstable importance and the model overfits.
checks.how: Compare importance ranks across folds, train-validation gaps and previous cutoff experiments.

checks.check: A fixed cap or stale selection file excludes newly useful feature families.
checks.how: Compare current column names and importance ranks with the cached selection list and selected-feature counts.

checks.check: A particular added feature group coincides with a regression or contributes only redundant signal.
checks.how: Inspect the feature diff, previous group ablations and residual correlations while model settings are fixed.

checks.check: Feature ranking was computed using the same holdout that is used to report the selected model score.
checks.how: Trace selection-fit indices and final evaluation indices.

checks.check: Whitespace, spelling changes or text cropping differ from the trained tokenizer inputs.
checks.how: Compare token IDs and retained spans for identical examples under training and inference preprocessing.

checks.check: Small visual details are lost at the current image resize and compatible higher-resolution inference is available.
checks.how: Inspect resized samples, training resolution metadata and a prior resolution-only comparison.

checks.check: Input scale, channel order or reshape differs from the checkpoint training pipeline.
checks.how: Compare numerical summaries and rendered inputs from training and inference for the same raw example.

checks.check: The current time-frequency transform blurs transient events or narrow spectral patterns.
checks.how: Inspect spectrograms and FFT window, hop and dynamic-range settings alongside training metadata.

checks.check: Raw signals show fixed-frequency interference or extreme amplitude artifacts.
checks.how: Inspect power spectra and amplitude histograms before preprocessing.

checks.check: The labeled event occupies only part of the available time or image extent.
checks.how: Compare annotation windows and representative crops with the model input region.

checks.check: An available channel or modality captures structure not present in the active input.
checks.how: Inspect input schemas, channel coverage and earlier modality ablations or per-modality errors.

checks.check: Existing checkpoints were trained with different transforms from the proposed inference change.
checks.how: Compare the candidate transform settings with each checkpoint manifest.

checks.check: The active estimator supports NaNs and prior imputation erased useful missingness patterns.
checks.how: Inspect estimator support and compare missingness-conditioned validation errors with and without filling.

checks.check: The active neural or other estimator fails on NaNs or unseen categorical values.
checks.how: Run a small batch containing those cases and inspect finite-output checks and encoder behavior.

checks.check: Scaling, rounding or sparse-column filtering has no demonstrated benefit for the active tree model.
checks.how: Read isolated preprocessing ablations and compare retained signal and validation scores.

checks.check: A localized training subset has unreliable labels, duplicates or a distribution unlike the test population.
checks.how: Inspect annotator agreement, repeated IDs, out-of-fold residuals and source-conditioned distributions.

checks.check: Additional labeled examples have compatible labels and usable input formats.
checks.how: Audit label definitions, source overlap, shape compatibility and source-specific validation results.

checks.check: Unlabeled examples are available and a validated teacher produces sufficiently confident predictions.
checks.how: Inspect teacher calibration and pseudo-label confidence and coverage by class on held-out labeled examples.

checks.check: The target metric exposes errors concentrated in an underrepresented class or population.
checks.how: Compare class counts and per-class or per-population held-out errors with the metric weighting.

checks.check: Minority examples admit meaningful interpolation and earlier synthetic-data tests improved held-out results.
checks.how: Inspect feature neighborhoods and synthetic examples, and read matched augmented-versus-original trials.

checks.check: Stricter filtering would remove most examples of a valid target class or population.
checks.how: Tabulate retained counts and target distributions under the proposed filters.

checks.check: Errors concentrate on structure present in raw data but absent from the current features.
checks.how: Inspect residual examples against current feature definitions and raw history, text or metadata.

checks.check: The feature matrix is large or recently expanded and selection artifacts may be stale.
checks.how: Compare feature schemas, selection lists and recent feature-group ablations.

checks.check: A fixed trained model receives text, images or signals whose representation can be checked against training.
checks.how: Inspect preprocessing code, checkpoint metadata and paired rendered or tokenized examples.

checks.check: Missing values, unseen categories or unnecessary scaling dominate preprocessing failures or ablation results.
checks.how: Inspect missingness profiles, encoder coverage and model-specific finite-output checks.

checks.check: The limiting evidence concerns label quality, class coverage or availability of more examples.
checks.how: Review label agreement, population counts and available labeled or unlabeled sources.

checks.check: Observed outcomes are censored, group-conditioned or encoded on a scale poorly matched to direct regression.
checks.how: Inspect target definitions, censoring indicators, group outcome distributions and existing transforms.

checks.check: The loss and output activation optimize a different target structure from the task metric.
checks.how: Compare training objective, output ranges and task scoring, and inspect custom gradient and Hessian calculations.

checks.check: Training and validation performance are both weak at the current tree depth or leaf count.
checks.how: Read learning curves and capacity-only sweeps on the same feature set.

checks.check: Training improves while validation degrades as model complexity or feature count grows.
checks.how: Compare train-validation curves and depth, penalty and subsampling ablations.

checks.check: Training stops while validation is still improving or a lower learning rate has not been given enough rounds.
checks.how: Inspect learning-rate schedules, best-iteration positions and stopping patience relative to the training limit.

checks.check: The dataset is limited and label-preserving transformations represent variation expected at test time.
checks.how: Inspect transformed examples, label semantics and augmentation-only validation trials.

checks.check: Repeated augmentation-strength changes have already failed to improve the fixed baseline.
checks.how: Read controlled transform-probability and magnitude sweeps and compare with repeated-run variation.

checks.check: A strong backbone is followed by only a minimal pooled linear head.
checks.how: Inspect the model graph and previous attention or hidden-layer ablations.

checks.check: Separate heads or extra normalization layers underperform a simpler shared head.
checks.how: Compare controlled head experiments with matching weights and inspect train-validation gaps.

checks.check: Multiple modality embeddings are available but their current combination discards distinct information.
checks.how: Inspect embedding shapes and the fusion operator, and review addition-versus-concatenation ablations.

checks.check: The proposed head differs from the saved weights and no matching retrained checkpoint is available.
checks.how: Compare layer names and tensor shapes with the checkpoint state.

checks.check: The current model underfits and a trained larger variant is available with compatible inputs.
checks.how: Compare train and validation learning curves and available checkpoint manifests.

checks.check: Larger variants fail to beat the established smaller model under matched evaluation.
checks.how: Read standalone checkpoint scores with fixed preprocessing, thresholds and fold count.

checks.check: The current pretraining domain or architecture misses structure visible in persistent errors.
checks.how: Inspect error cases and compare available domain-pretrained, convolutional, transformer or signal-model candidates.

checks.check: The input is a small or unconventional pseudo-image and larger backbones previously added no signal.
checks.how: Inspect input dimensions and controlled backbone-size ablations.

checks.check: Several compatible training runs or stages exist but have not been compared with one fixed inference path.
checks.how: List saved checkpoints and their validation, stage and configuration metadata.

checks.check: Checkpoint-only tuning has stalled and available architectures or pretraining sources offer a different representation.
checks.how: Compare recent checkpoint trials and inspect the compatible candidate backbone inventory.

checks.check: Backbone features are strong but pooling, output heads or modality fusion remain minimal or poorly validated.
checks.how: Inspect the model graph and component-level ablations.

checks.check: Tabular features are stable and a different boosting method or interface offers the required optimization controls.
checks.how: Inspect current library constraints, callback needs and previous same-feature framework trials.

checks.check: A newer checkpoint has worse independent validation despite being from a later training stage.
checks.how: Compare stage-specific held-out scores under identical inference settings.

checks.check: Existing members make highly correlated errors and a reasonable candidate differs in inputs, targets or architecture.
checks.how: Compare aligned held-out residual correlations and candidate standalone scores.

checks.check: A member removal improves held-out performance or the full blend fails to beat its best component.
checks.how: Read leave-one-out and single-member ablations at fixed aggregation settings.

checks.check: Additional compatible folds or seeds are available and prior additions reduce prediction variance.
checks.how: Inspect checkpoint provenance, fold coverage and the marginal score curve as repeats were added.

checks.check: Increasing repeat count has repeatedly failed while different model families have complementary errors.
checks.how: Compare repeat-count sweeps and residual correlations across families.

checks.check: A component or upstream preprocessing changed since the current subset was chosen.
checks.how: Compare current manifests with the versions used for the last member ablation.

checks.check: The metric depends on ordering and members use incompatible output scales or target transforms.
checks.how: Read the metric and plot per-member score distributions and rank correlations on aligned validation rows.

checks.check: Raw magnitudes carry useful information and rank conversion has repeatedly failed under the current configuration.
checks.how: Compare raw and rank averages on the same saved predictions with unchanged weights.

checks.check: The task scores probability distributions and logits are available before normalization.
checks.how: Inspect loss expectations, saved tensor semantics and row sums after each candidate aggregation.

checks.check: The upstream model changed after the last raw-versus-rank comparison.
checks.how: Compare checkpoint and preprocessing manifests with those of the previous comparison.

checks.check: Members differ substantially in quality and a small contribution from a complementary weaker member helps.
checks.how: Read standalone, equal-blend and small-weight trials on the same validation predictions.

checks.check: Tuned weights fail to beat equal averaging beyond repeated-evaluation uncertainty.
checks.how: Compare coefficient sweeps with the uniform baseline using repeated seeds or an independent holdout.

checks.check: A member was upgraded or its prediction scale changed after weights were selected.
checks.how: Compare component manifests and prediction distributions with the last coefficient-fitting run.

checks.check: Only a small public score sample supports highly specific member or class weights.
checks.how: Inspect the provenance and number of independent examples used for coefficient selection.

checks.check: Member output scales or probability conventions differ.
checks.how: Inspect raw output ranges, activation placement and target-transform definitions.

checks.check: Members are already aligned to a common convention but their contributions are poorly balanced.
checks.how: Compare per-member quality, current weights and fixed-domain coefficient trials.

checks.check: Cross-fitted base predictions are available with enough held-out data to fit and validate a meta-learner.
checks.how: Check OOF provenance and split sizes, then inspect prior linear-stack versus fixed-blend results.

checks.check: Meta-learner fitting reused in-sample base predictions or its gains vanish on independent data.
checks.how: Trace base-fit, meta-fit and final-evaluation row indices and compare the resulting scores.

checks.check: Flips, mirrored channels or alternate crops preserve the task label and were compatible with training.
checks.how: Inspect domain semantics, transformed examples and the checkpoint augmentation recipe.

checks.check: A transform exchanges meaningful frequency, time or channel positions without a valid symmetry.
checks.how: Compare transformed input axes and channel semantics with the labeling rule.

checks.check: Controlled TTA trials show no reliable gain for this checkpoint or ensemble.
checks.how: Compare identity-only and transformed-view predictions under identical seeds and aggregation.

checks.check: Current errors vary by crop or orientation and averaging available valid views helped prior trials.
checks.how: Inspect per-view held-out errors and the matched averaging ablation.

checks.check: The pool lacks independent predictions or includes demonstrably harmful members.
checks.how: Inspect per-member scores, residual correlations and leave-one-out ablations.

checks.check: The member pool is stable but output conventions or coefficient choices have not been validated.
checks.how: Compare saved prediction distributions and previous combination-rule experiments.

checks.check: Valid alternate input views are available for the same trained checkpoints.
checks.how: Inspect transform semantics, checkpoint metadata and matched TTA trial results.

checks.check: Inference budget cannot accommodate further model or view passes but saved predictions are available.
checks.how: Compare measured pass times with the remaining budget and inspect saved prediction artifacts.

checks.check: Targets occupy discrete ordered levels and the metric is sensitive to class boundaries or ties.
checks.how: Inspect the training target histogram and compute the metric on a saved prediction sample under rounding and continuous output.

checks.check: Threshold fitting improves tuning folds but loses to simple rounding on independent folds.
checks.how: Compare fitted cutpoints with fixed rounding on an untouched calibration-evaluation split.

checks.check: The metric is unchanged by strictly monotone rescaling and no discretization gain has been established.
checks.how: Read the scoring implementation and compare rankings before and after the proposed rescaling.

checks.check: A new checkpoint or blend has shifted the prediction distribution since thresholds were fitted.
checks.how: Compare output histograms and threshold-crossing counts with the original calibration predictions.

checks.check: Discretization collapses an output column to a constant or introduces harmful ties.
checks.how: Count unique outputs and inspect per-column rank variance under the candidate boundaries.

checks.check: The current output is already valid and additional random perturbations only reorder close predictions.
checks.how: Inspect the task metric and compare deterministic outputs with prior noise-injection trials.

checks.check: Outputs have the wrong direction, link function, range or calibration for the required predictions.
checks.how: Read submission semantics and inspect score signs, ranges, probability sums and calibration plots.

checks.check: The required labels are discrete or the rank metric is affected by the target tie structure.
checks.how: Inspect label support, the scoring implementation and current rounding behavior.

checks.check: A known subgroup or metadata rule explains systematic residuals beyond the current model.
checks.how: Compare group-conditioned errors and the reliability of the proposed indicator on held-out rows.

checks.check: The proposed subgroup correction uses information unavailable or differently defined at inference.
checks.how: Compare training and test schemas and trace how each correction indicator is produced.

checks.check: The proposed transform is strictly monotone on a single output and evaluation only uses ordering.
checks.how: Check the mathematical transform and compare prediction ranks before and after it.

checks.check: The pipeline crashes or fails output, alignment or checkpoint-consistency checks.
checks.how: Inspect the first failing log entry and a tiny end-to-end run including the saved prediction file.

checks.check: Current score differences are confounded, noisy or based on an unrepresentative validation split.
checks.how: Compare version diffs, unchanged reruns, fold membership and independent scores.

checks.check: Error analysis points to missing information, label problems or input representation mismatch.
checks.how: Inspect residual examples with raw data, feature schemas, annotation quality and preprocessing metadata.

checks.check: Learning curves show undertraining, overfitting or an objective mismatch with usable current inputs.
checks.how: Inspect train-validation curves, stopping points and the relationship between loss and task scoring.

checks.check: The current model has plateaued and compatible alternative checkpoints or architectures are available.
checks.how: Review controlled recent trials and the manifest of trained candidate models.

checks.check: Multiple valid predictors or valid alternate input views have complementary errors.
checks.how: Compare aligned held-out predictions, residual correlations and per-view errors.

checks.check: Predictions are valid but their scale, discretization or subgroup bias mismatches the scoring requirements.
checks.how: Inspect task scoring, label support, calibration plots and subgroup residuals.

checks.check: Measured runtime or peak memory prevents completing planned validation experiments.
checks.how: Read stage timings and memory logs from a representative run.
